envelope.sessions: PublicSession[]; empty on no-data/failure; never fall back from live to sample

PublicSession.id: opaque stable PUBLIC occurrence ID; distinct from Google event ID
PublicSession.end: HH:mm JST, greater than start; cross-day sessions excluded pending separate policy
PublicSession.confirmedBookingCount: integer >=0 only when verified; otherwise null
PublicSession.bookingCountSource: approved server aggregate source label or null, never private DB IDs
PublicSession.capacity: verified positive integer, default10 only under approved policy
PublicSession.updatedAt: RFC3339 public row update timestamp or null

derivedStates.full: bookingCountStatus=known AND source verified AND confirmedBookingCount>=capacity
derivedStates.count_unknown: count null or status unknown or source missing; never display0 or promise seats
derivedStates.cancelled: publicStatus=CANCELLED; show details only, no application composer
derivedStates.search_empty: successful loaded dataset plus zero matches; different from acquisition failure

selection.storage: in-memory + public occurrence ID in hash only; no localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies
selection.draft: in-memory through internal navigation; cleared by reload

durationReference.meaning: standard request durations, not availability or confirmed price
